description: The chart illustrates the distribution of datasets by year, categorized into "Untargeted" and "Targeted" groups, from 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents the years, labeled in a linear sequence from 2012 to 2022, while the vertical axis is labeled "Number of datasets" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 160, marked at intervals of 20. Each year is represented by a pair of bars: "Untargeted" datasets are depicted in blue and "Targeted" datasets in orange. The height of each bar corresponds to the number of datasets for that category in a given year. The number of "Targeted" datasets consistently exceeds that of "Untargeted" ones across most years, with both categories showing an overall increase over time. Specifically, the number of "Targeted" datasets rises from 1 in 2012 to approximately 155 in 2021, with notable increases observed between 2018 and 2021. In contrast, "Untargeted" datasets grow from 0 in 2012 to around 65 in 2021. The data for 2022 is incomplete, as indicated by a lighter shade for both categories. The bars are grouped by year, with no specific sorting or visual emphasis applied to any particular year or category.
